items.title: Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft stocks surge as AI hyperscalers post strong earnings results
items.summary: Shares of hyperscaler companies climbed higher on Monday.

items.title: Amazon Tops $3T, Meta Rallies 7% as AI Hyperscalers Ride Earnings Momentum
items.summary: Blowout cloud earnings and a sudden geopolitical thaw sent the biggest AI names surging Monday, but the question investors are scrambling to answer is whether the rally signals a lasting regime change or just a relief bounce before the next round of capex anxiety.

items.title: Salesforce Remains Down But Turning Positive: 100%+ Returns Lie Ahead According to This Analyst
items.summary: Salesforce has shed nearly a third of its value this year while continuing to beat earnings estimates, and at least one analyst on Wall Street thinks that disconnect sets up a return most investors are not pricing in.

items.title: Why Oracle Stock Is Gaining
items.summary: Oracle is catching a double tailwind from easing geopolitical tensions and an expanded AI partnership with Alphabet.

items.title: CoreWeave Jumps 11%, Snowflake Gains 6%, Oracle Climbs 5% as Risk-On Mood Lifts AI Cloud
items.summary: A sudden shift in geopolitical risk flipped the switch on AI cloud stocks Monday morning, sending CoreWeave, Snowflake, Oracle and Nebius sharply higher, but the group carries a history of giving back gains just as fast as it captures them.

items.title: Microsoft and Alphabet Can Absorb an AI Shock. Oracle Is the One to Watch.
items.summary: Which hyperscaler's balance sheet could ride out a rough stretch, and which couldn't? The gap between Microsoft and Oracle is wider than their spending suggests.

items.summary: Are all these AI spending figures actually comparable? Not quite, and the fine print is where this five-company story gets interesting.
